title: Victor Wembanyama Gets Honest About Portland Trail Blazers Ahead of Playoffs Matchup - NewsBreak
text:
By Shabiha Akter ,
1 hours ago
Victor Wembanyama (Image Credits: Imagn) Victor Wembanyama missed the playoffs in both his rookie season, 2023–24, and the following season, 2024–25. But in his third year, the French big man has finally guided the San Antonio Spurs back to the postseason. Wembanyama and the Spurs are now set to face the Portland Trail Blazers in the first round after Portland secured the game with a Tuesday victory over the Suns .
The Trail Blazers finished the regular season nearly 20 wins behind San Antonio. Still, Wembanyama isn’t underestimating the challenge. Speaking to reporters on Wednesday, the young star made it clear he expects a demanding series.
“Very intense. Not an easy team to play. They’re in the playoffs this year, but they’ve been a tanking team in past years and now a playoff team trying to contend. No matter through the years, they’re still hard to play. They have an identity. They’re strong ,” Wembanyama said.
Portland surged late with a 7–3 run over their final ten games to secure a play-in berth and eventually punch their playoff ticket. The pairing of Deni Avdija and Jrue Holiday has caused major problems for opponents. Hence, Wembanyama thinks the Spurs cannot afford to enter the postseason with the wrong mindset about Portland.
Victor Wembanyama Shares Rib Injury Update Wembanyama has also been dealing with a rib injury suffered late in the regular season. It raised concerns about his availability and condition for the playoffs. Still, the 22-year-old shared an encouraging update about his recovery.
“ I’m really close to being there. But during the season, you’re never really at 100%; there’s always something. But yeah, if we compare to regular season form, I’m close to being really good ,” he said.
Victor Wembanyama (Image Credits: Imagn) Wembanyama played a major role in helping the Spurs finish as the No. 2 seed in the Western Conference. Despite worries about meeting the 65-game eligibility requirement , he reached the mark by appearing in the late-season game against the Dallas Mavericks.
Even so, San Antonio continues to carefully monitor their franchise centerpiece after he dealt with several injuries throughout the season. The hope is that Wembanyama can stay healthy and lead the Spurs deep into the playoffs while continuing his pursuit of MVP and DPOY honors .
